snippet.title: Veinrider Demo Announcement!
snippet.description:
🚀The demo for Veinrider is live! 

Veinrider is a short sci-fi incremental game about piloting a gravity-flipping mining craft through alien caves, mining resources, and upgrading your ship.

Dig → upgrade → push deeper.

👉 Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110670/Veinrider/

Incremental Growth: mine resources, trade them in, and steadily improve your ship’s shields, weapons, and systems.

Arcade Core Gameplay: simple gravity-flip controls inspired by classics—easy to pick up, satisfying to master.

Procedural Terrain: carve through alien caverns, uncover embedded minerals, and refine your path for efficiency. 

Corporate Mining Fantasy: exploit the planet for your employers, while you quietly prepare your own way out.

Dig, upgrade, and push deeper—until the planet gives up all it has to offer.

#gamedev #indiedev #incrementalgame #incrementalgames #scifi
